jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(5)(E) inventory: Westminster School District, a town school district in the Windham Northeast Supervisory Union (member town: Westminster). Operates PK-6/8; Westminster is also a member of the Bellows Falls Union High School District for grades 9-12.

board.post_note: Westminster SD: five directors elected by Australian ballot on Town Meeting Day, at mixed two- and three-year terms.

sources.note: Town of Westminster 2025 Annual Meeting minutes (official ballot results): Town School Director, 3-year term -- Christine "Tine" Biolsi; Town School Director, 2-year term -- Margie Kearns Ferry. School directors are elected by Australian ballot on Town Meeting Day under Article 1 of the combined Town / Fire District #3 / School District warning (official 2026 warning: https://www.westminstervt.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/2026-Warning-for-Town-Report.pdf). FLAGS: (1) Cheryl Charles's term end appears in no fetched official source (resolving document: the 2024 annual meeting minutes / town report officers list) -- minted with no end. (2) Karen Blanchard and Ron Bos-Lun: their March 2026 wins rest on the official sample ballot (Blanchard the printed candidate for the 2-year seat; the 3-year seat write-in-only) plus the March 5, 2026 reorganization minutes seating Bos-Lun as a "new board member" and both members' continuous seating -- minted ELECTED with the ballot-derived ends (2028 / 2029), disclosed; the certified 2026 return (in the town's 2026 Annual Meeting minutes, this town's format) was not fetched. Turnover: the Oct. 2, 2025 minutes discuss a "School Board Opening" with an interim appointment to run until March 2026 after Charlie Hutchison's 2025 death (the April 2, 2026 agenda carries a memorial-service item); Mariah Perkins was appointed interim (Nov. 6, 2025 agenda; listed as a member Dec. 4, 2025) and resigned Jan. 8, 2026 (minutes).

directors.name: Cheryl Charles
directors.note: Board Chair. Term end in no fetched official source -- see the flag in the board sources.

directors.name: Christine "Tine" Biolsi
directors.note: Vice Chair; elected March 2025 to a 3-year term (official results).

directors.name: Margie Kearns Ferry
directors.note: Board Clerk; elected March 2025 to a 2-year term (official results).

directors.name: Karen Blanchard
directors.note: Seated at the March 5, 2026 reorganization; the printed candidate for the 2-year seat on the official March 2026 sample ballot -- see flag (2) in the board sources.

directors.name: Ron Bos-Lun
directors.note: Named a "new board member" in the March 5, 2026 minutes; the ballot's only other race was the write-in-only 3-year seat -- see flag (2) in the board sources.

directors.name: Mariah Perkins
directors.note: Interim appointee to the vacancy left by Hutchison's death (Nov.-Dec. 2025 minutes chain); resigned Jan. 8, 2026 (minutes). Membership ended.

directors.name: Charles "Charlie" Hutchison
directors.note: Served through June 2025 (minutes); died in 2025 -- the seat was discussed as an opening Oct. 2, 2025 and the April 2026 agenda carries his memorial service. Membership ended; his elected term end was not published in a fetched source.
